_meta.description: 200 body of POST /api/invites/redeem (rest-api.md §7.5.5) — the only sharing payload an invited party ever sees. `ownerFirstName` is the sharing owner's FIRST NAME only (no surname, no email, no user id). `vehicles` are ordinary viewer-masked VehicleSummary rows, identical in shape to §7.0, so the client can seed its catalog from this one response; always non-empty, every row `role: viewer` with a `sharePermission`.
